example: A policeman was killed in the car raid. Customs men raided Daniel's factory last evening.
example_zh: 一名警察在這次汽車襲擊中喪生。昨晚海關人員突襲了丹尼爾的工廠。
memory_hint: raid 可作名詞或動詞，表示突襲、襲擊；動詞三態為 raid, raided, raided。

example: The invoice is subject to our ratification.
example_zh: 這張發票要經我們批准後才有效。
memory_hint: ratify 表「批准、認可」，-ation 為名詞字尾。

example: Grandfather is trying to rationalize what happened, but he cannot do it.
example_zh: 祖父一直試圖將所發生的一切合理化，但他做不到。
memory_hint: rationalize 表把事情解釋得合理。

example: Sherry's father is a real estate agent.
example_zh: 雪莉的父親是房地產仲介。
memory_hint: real estate 指土地、房屋等不動產。

example: Jane recalled that her son had left early this morning.
example_zh: 珍想起她的兒子今天一早就離開了。
memory_hint: recall 可指回想，也可指召回或撤銷。

example: Do you think Mary's proposal is receivable?
example_zh: 你認為瑪麗的建議可接受嗎？
memory_hint: receive + able，表示可以接受的。

example: Can you recognize Linda from this picture?
example_zh: 你能從這張照片中認出琳達嗎？
memory_hint: recognize 表辨認出、承認或認可。

example: Charles is recuperating from illness.
example_zh: 查爾斯病後正在漸漸康復。
memory_hint: recuperate 指病後恢復健康；三態 recuperate, recuperated, recuperated。

example: Our family doctor says that taking extra vitamins may reduce your liability to colds.
example_zh: 我們的家庭醫生說多吃一些維生素會減少你得感冒的可能性。
memory_hint: reduce 表減少、降低；動詞三態為 reduce, reduced, reduced。

example: The local authorities agreed to hold a referendum on the issue in May.
example_zh: 當地政府同意在五月舉行公民投票來決定這個問題。
memory_hint: referendum 指把公共議題交由公民投票決定；複數為 referendums。

example: People firmly demand to reform social abuses. The people's request for reforms must be made to the education system.
example_zh: 人們強烈要求革除社會弊端。人們要求對教育體制進行改革。
memory_hint: re + form，表示重新塑造，引申為改革、改良。

example: Joan's argument can not be refuted at the moment.
example_zh: 瓊的這一論點時下還無法駁斥。
memory_hint: refute 指用證據或論證駁倒。

example: It's wrong of anyone to get around the regulation.
example_zh: 任何人存心逃避規章制度都是不對的。
memory_hint: regulation 指規則、規章或管理制度。

example: The accident prompted Hill to rehabilitate his insurance.
example_zh: 這件意外事故促使希爾恢復投保。
memory_hint: rehabilitate 表修復、復原或使恢復原有地位。

example: The bank has been pressing Tony for reimbursement of the loan.
example_zh: 銀行催促湯尼償還貸款。
memory_hint: reimburse 表償還、補償，-ment 為名詞字尾。

example: Juan kept off smoking for a few days, but now he has relapsed. Daniel had a relapse and died soon after.
example_zh: 胡安戒菸三天，可是現在又恢復抽菸。丹尼爾舊病復發，不久就死去了。
memory_hint: re + lapse，表示回到先前不良狀態，可作動詞或名詞。

example: The doctor told me this medicine would relieve my headache.
example_zh: 醫生說這藥將減輕我的頭痛。
memory_hint: relieve 表減輕痛苦、解除負擔；三態 relieve, relieved, relieved。

example: This young man was very reluctant to help others.
example_zh: 這個年輕人不太願意幫助別人。
memory_hint: reluctant 常接 to V，表示不願意做某事；比較級 more reluctant。

example: My friends remain in Beijing until June.
example_zh: 我的朋友們在北京一直待到六月。
memory_hint: remain 表留下、保持；動詞三態 remain, remained, remained。

example: This picture reminds me of my hometown.
example_zh: 這幅圖畫使我想起我的家鄉。
memory_hint: remind 常用 remind A of B，表示使 A 想起 B。

example: A postman's remuneration is £150 per week.
example_zh: 郵差的報酬為每週一百五十英鎊。
memory_hint: remuneration 指工作或服務所得的報酬。

example: Our manager is very delighted at the renewal of negotiation.
example_zh: 我們經理對談判能重新開始感到很高興。
memory_hint: re + new + al，表示重新更新的過程。

example: The entire fabric of the old library needs renovation.
example_zh: 這座舊圖書館的全部結構需要維修翻新。
memory_hint: renovation 指翻修、整修或更新。

example: Video rental is usually £3 per week. Arthur has a video rental shop.
example_zh: 錄影帶出租通常每週三英鎊。亞瑟經營一家錄影帶出租店。
chinese: 出租；租金；租借的；出租的
memory_hint: rental 可作名詞表示出租或租金，也可作形容詞表示租借的。

example: Nowadays robots are replacing workers on assembly lines.
example_zh: 如今機器人逐漸代替了裝配線上的工人。
memory_hint: replace 常用 replace A with/by B，表示用 B 取代 A。

example: The dove represents peace in many countries.
example_zh: 在許多國家，鴿子象徵和平。
memory_hint: represent 表代表、象徵；三態 represent, represented, represented。

example: Everyone knows the military regime was repressive.
example_zh: 每個人都知道軍閥統治得很鎮壓。
memory_hint: repressive 指壓制性的、鎮壓性的。

example: This supermarket has a fine reputation.
example_zh: 這家超市信譽很好。
memory_hint: reputation 指名聲、公眾評價，可好可壞。

example: Brown's driver licence was rescinded after the crash.
example_zh: 布朗的駕駛執照在事故後被吊銷。
memory_hint: rescind 指正式撤銷、廢止；三態 rescind, rescinded, rescinded。

example: People are used to keeping a large reserve of cabbage for winter in the north of China. Blair has reserved a table at the new restaurant.
example_zh: 在中國北方，人們常儲存大量白菜以備冬天之用。布萊爾已在那家新飯店預訂了一桌菜。
chinese: 儲藏；預備；保留；保留地；儲備；預定
memory_hint: reserve 可作名詞或動詞，表示保留、儲備或預訂。

example: Generally speaking, a healthy body resists disease.
example_zh: 一般而言，健康的身體能抵抗疾病。
memory_hint: resist 表抵抗、忍住，後面可接名詞或 V-ing。

example: Resources management is an important business skill.
example_zh: 資源管理是一項重要的經營技能。
memory_hint: resource 的名詞複數為 resources。

example: Generally speaking, the stolen property must be restored to its owner.
example_zh: 一般而言，贓物必須歸還原主。
memory_hint: restore 表恢復原狀或歸還；三態 restore, restored, restored。

example: The sale of firearms is subject to many legal restrictions in China.
example_zh: 在中國，出售槍枝受到許多法律的限制。
memory_hint: restrict 表限制，-ion 為名詞字尾。

example: Jennifer is required to submit a resume firstly. Mrs. Hughes resumed her maiden name after the divorce.
example_zh: 珍妮佛被要求先交一份履歷表。休斯太太離婚後恢復使用娘家姓。
chinese: 摘要；概括；履歷；重新開始；繼續；恢復
memory_hint: resume 可作名詞 résumé（履歷），也可作動詞表示恢復、繼續。

example: In this area, all attempts to resuscitate the fishing industry were foredoomed to failure.
example_zh: 在這個地區，所有讓漁業復甦的嘗試都註定失敗。
memory_hint: resuscitate 指使恢復生機、復甦；三態 resuscitate, resuscitated, resuscitated。

example: A politician should be a retainer of the people.
example_zh: 政治家應是人民的公僕。
memory_hint: retainer 可指受雇服務者、侍從或長期受聘者。

example: Heaven's retaliation is slow but sure.
example_zh: 天的報應雖慢，卻是一定會來的。
memory_hint: retaliation 指報復、反擊；retaliate 為動詞。

example: Marvin likes to go to his mountain retreat for the weekend. As a friend, I will not retreat from my commitments.
example_zh: 馬文週末喜歡去山中的休養所。作為朋友，我不會從我的承諾中退縮。
memory_hint: retreat 可作名詞表示休養所，也可作動詞表示撤退、退縮。

example: At present, oil revenue has risen with the rise in the dollar.
example_zh: 目前石油收入因美元增值而增加。
memory_hint: revenue 指收入、營收或稅收。

example: Mario's neighbors both loved and reviled him in the same breath.
example_zh: 馬里奧的鄰居喜愛他的同時又辱罵他。
memory_hint: revile 指以惡言辱罵、斥責；三態 revile, reviled, reviled。

example: His speech contains impassioned rhetoric.
example_zh: 他的演講含有熱情洋溢的修辭。
memory_hint: rhetoric 除指修辭學，也可指華麗或浮誇的言辭。

example: She was ready for any risks. The brave mother risked her life to save her child.
example_zh: 她準備冒一切風險。那位勇敢的母親冒著生命危險去救她的孩子。
memory_hint: risk 可作名詞或動詞；動詞三態 risk, risked, risked。

example: Juan drives carefully up the rocky lane.
example_zh: 胡安小心地沿著石頭小巷開去。
memory_hint: rocky 的比較級為 rockier，最高級 rockiest。

example: 476 AD saw the ruin of the Roman Empire. The hurricane ruined our holiday.
example_zh: 公元四七六年羅馬帝國滅亡。颶風把我們的假期徹底搞毀了。
memory_hint: ruin 可作名詞或動詞；動詞三態 ruin, ruined, ruined。

example: Generally speaking, parents often make sacrifices for their children in China. The ancient Greeks sacrificed lambs or calves before engaging in battle.
example_zh: 一般而言，中國的父母親常常為子女做出犧牲。古希臘人在戰前都要獻祭羔羊或小牛。
chinese: 祭品；犧牲；犧牲；獻出；獻祭
memory_hint: sacrifice 可作名詞或動詞；三態 sacrifice, sacrificed, sacrificed。

example: My money comes mainly from salary.
example_zh: 我的錢主要來自工資。
memory_hint: salary 指固定薪資、薪水。

example: Please send me a sample copy of the book. The inspector sampled the stuff and found it satisfactory.
example_zh: 請寄給我一本樣品書。那位檢驗員抽樣檢查這批材料，而且感到滿意。
chinese: 範例；樣品；標本；抽取樣品
memory_hint: sample 可作名詞或動詞；三態 sample, sampled, sampled。

example: Nowadays there is no sanction for autocracy. At this point, I can't sanction your methods.
example_zh: 如今誰也不贊成獨裁統治。在這點上，我不會同意你的辦法。
chinese: 批准；認可；制裁；處罰；同意
memory_hint: sanction 可指批准、認可，也可指制裁；動詞三態 sanction, sanctioned, sanctioned。

example: The moon is the Earth's satellite.
example_zh: 月球是地球的衛星。
memory_hint: satellite 的名詞複數為 satellites。

example: Generally speaking, saving is getting.
example_zh: 一般而言，節約等於增加收入。
memory_hint: saving 可表示存款或節約。

example: After lunch, one of my colleagues likes to have two scoops of ice cream. Badgers scoop out a hole in the sand.
example_zh: 午餐後，我的一位同事喜歡吃兩球冰淇淋。獾在沙地上挖了個洞。
chinese: 鏟子；舀取；獨家新聞；汲取；挖掘
memory_hint: scoop 可作名詞或動詞；三態 scoop, scooped, scooped。

example: The jeweler scrutinized the diamond for flaws.
example_zh: 那位寶石商仔細察看鑽石有無瑕疵。
memory_hint: scrutinize 表仔細檢查、審視；三態 scrutinize, scrutinized, scrutinized。

example: I hope my boyfriend has made me feel secure. You had better secure all the doors and windows before leaving.
example_zh: 我希望我的男友使我覺得安心。要把所有門窗關好再出門。
chinese: 安全的；無慮的；使…安全；固定；獲得
memory_hint: secure 可作形容詞表示安全的，也可作動詞表示確保、固定或取得。

example: Water seeks its own level.
example_zh: 水能找到自己的水平。
memory_hint: seek 為不規則動詞：seek, sought, sought。

example: Generally speaking, people should seize each chance, otherwise they'll regret it.
example_zh: 一般而言，人們應該抓住任何一個機會，否則就會後悔。
memory_hint: seize 表抓住、把握；動詞三態 seize, seized, seized。

example: Anita's boyfriend is her senior by six years. My father was a senior officer in the company.
example_zh: 安尼塔的男朋友比她大六歲。他父親曾是那家公司的高級職員。
chinese: 年長者；上司；年長的；高級的；資深的
memory_hint: senior 可作名詞或形容詞，表示年長者、上司或資深的。

example: Nita cannot settle to work this afternoon.
example_zh: 今天下午尼特無法定下心來工作。
memory_hint: settle 表安頓、定居、解決或使平靜；三態 settle, settled, settled。

example: At present, there is still a lot of subtle sexism on television and in magazines.
example_zh: 如今在電視和雜誌上仍存在許多性別歧視的現象。
memory_hint: sex + ism，指以性別為基礎的歧視。

example: The shareholders ask for a general meeting.
example_zh: 股東們要求召開一個股東大會。
memory_hint: share 表股份，holder 表持有人，合起來即股東；複數 shareholders。

example: We think better to postpone the shipment than to cancel the contract.
example_zh: 我們認為延期裝運比取消合約好。
memory_hint: shipment 可指裝運行為或一批貨物。

example: We have to force a showdown.
example_zh: 我們得迫使對方攤牌。
memory_hint: showdown 指決定性對決或攤牌。

example: With a shrug, he went out of the room.
example_zh: 他聳一下肩，走出房間。
memory_hint: shrug 可作名詞或動詞；動詞三態 shrug, shrugged, shrugged。

example: Ally has been Betty's sidekick since primary school.
example_zh: 打從小學開始，艾麗和貝蒂一直就是好朋友。
memory_hint: sidekick 指親近的夥伴、助手或同夥。

example: The shell of a snail is its skeleton.
example_zh: 蝸牛的殼就是它的骨骼。
memory_hint: skeleton 的名詞複數為 skeletons。

example: Parker is a skillful football player.
example_zh: 帕克是位熟練的足球員。
memory_hint: skillful 的比較級 more skillful，最高級 most skillful。

example: Can't David get it into his thick skull that Betty likes him?
example_zh: 大衛難道還不明白貝蒂喜歡他嗎？
memory_hint: skull 的名詞複數為 skulls。

example: There is a sluggish management team in our company.
example_zh: 我們公司有一個管理遲鈍的團隊。
memory_hint: sluggish 的比較級 more sluggish，最高級 most sluggish。
